outcome: Readmission rate within 6 weeks of discharge
cohort: Women who presented to Mount Sinai Hospital for delivery admission from March to May 2019 versus March to May 2020
finding: Despite shorter hospital stays during the COVID-19 pandemic, there was no difference in readmission rates within 6 weeks of discharge.
mod_finding: Earlier maternal discharge occurred during COVID-19, but shorter maternal postpartum stay did not increase readmission rate.
